title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Line: A few years ago
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Referee
rows.Line: 4-0! Shibuya Diamonds SC wins!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Good game!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Shota, you looked like you were out of gas in the second half. You gotta work on your conditioning more.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to run more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: As long as you understand...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But your goal at the end was so cool, Akito. You really are our team's ace!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
An ace can't be an ace if they don't score, right?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Haha. And we don't expect anything less from you.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But since we've made it this far, we're gonna win it all. That means we're definitely winning our next one too.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, but our next opponent is really good too... You sure we can beat them?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: What are you saying that for? We've just gotta win no matter who we end up playing against!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to run more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Well, whenever you're in trouble, just know that you can pass the ball off to me...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Akito's kinda scary on the outside, but he's really a nice guy that everybody can count on...)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Thanks, Akito...!
Let's win the next tournament too!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: That's right, I'll be there to take down whoever comes at us!
The day before the tournament

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Alright, the tournament's tomorrow. No mistakes from here on out...!)
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hm? Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito? But practice is over...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Nice work out there, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're still here?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I could be asking you the same thing. You stayed behind to practice more?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yup. We're playing against a pretty good team tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: And it's our last match as sixth graders. We can't leave anything behind on our way out.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Just like a true ace...!
You're the coolest, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Quit exaggerating, will you?
I just don't want to miss out, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hey, can I stay and practice with you?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I wanna do everything I can too!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Shota...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Alright, but no running out of gas like that other time.
The day of the tournament - Quarterfinals

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Alright, win this one and we're through to the finals!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: The other team's full of kids that were pulled from famous junior clubs, but we made it this far, so we're gonna win this thing...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Of course we are. There's no way we're gonna lose!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Opponent Player A
rows.Line: Nice, we're racking up goals left and right. We've got this!

rows.Speaker: Opponent Player B
rows.Line: Hey, it's not over yet.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Dammit, they're up three goals already!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (They just keep catching our defenders off guard by slipping behind them...!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (We're gonna lose at this rate...!)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: They're playing like they're the favorites...

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: They're too good. There's no way we can beat them...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, don't give up yet!
We decided that we're gonna win it all, right?!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Get the ball to me the next time you can. I'll get a goal for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Just don't give up until it's over, alright? Just run! Keep running! Don't let go!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Yeah, we're not losing this...!
It all starts with one goal...!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (B-But...)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
(They're defending way too well.
I can't get it by them...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hah...! There!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
(Oh, Akito, wow...!
He peeled that guy off like it was nothing!)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Now's my chance to get the ball to him...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Over here...!!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito...!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_004
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_005
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_006
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yes, that's one!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: W-We did it...!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: Whoa, they got through all those defenders...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we're just getting started.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna win this match and the whole tournament! We've gotta keep scoring!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: Yeah!!

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line: They score a goal...

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line: That kid's good. I lost him for a second there.

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line:
But no more...
Let's regroup and get back out there!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_006

rows.Speaker: Referee
rows.Line: Musashino East scores!!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, they scored again!
And they're back up three?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: The Shibuya Diamonds just can't keep up, and they've got less than five minutes... Can they pull this off...?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: No, seriously...?!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
They're totally in control now...
We can't even get a hold of the ball anymore.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
No, we still have time!!
Don't give up until it's over!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
(Dammit, dammit...!
Nothing's working...!!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (We said we'd win...! I said we'd win...! Things can't end like this!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Dammit...!!
se_event_natsumatsuri_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Referee
rows.Line: 5-1! Musashino East wins!

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line: Good game!!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Good game...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Man, we got beat...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
We couldn't we win?!
We worked so hard to get here...!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: We just never stood a chance...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: You guys...! Don't say stuff like that! That's when it really becomes impossible to win!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: No, we really didn't stand a chance! Musashino East is full of kids that left home and came all the way here to just play soccer, right?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I heard that they practice forever after school too. It's like they're never not kicking around a ball.

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I mean, they're all serious about going pro, right? They're sacrificing all their free time just to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (But I always took soccer seriously and did everything I could...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (I never even thought about leaving home to practice playing soccer from dawn to dusk.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (But still, I was being serious... I...)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: There's no way we could beat anyone who's that focused on their goals...
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: That was a rough match. It would've been nice to finish the sixth grade with a win... But we still managed to score a goal against them, so that counts, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, you're gonna keep playing in junior high, right? Let's join the same team!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I'm gonna quit...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Playing against those guys made me realize something today...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: They made me doubt how serious I was about playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I asked myself if I could do more than they're doing right now, if I could do more in the future...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: And I couldn't think of an answer...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
I'm such a loser...
I talked so big and acted like some kind of bigshot...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But now I don't know what to do. That just means I wasn't really that serious to begin with...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: That's why I'm quitting...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But I thought you were the most serious about playing soccer out of all of us! Sure the other team was really good, but you're our ace...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, Shota.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But that's just not enough.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I'll never be happy with just that...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being such a useless Ace.
Bye...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
Akito, please don't quit...!
Live House
Who would've thought that we'd run into each other here...!
Akito and his team might just turn this event on its head...
Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: I don't think we even need to tally scores here. The BAD DOGS win! Talk about an awesome song...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, give us one more!
You gotta give us an encore!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Just one more!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Looks like you've made some friends, BAD DOGS. What do you say, you two?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why not?
We've still got plenty left in the tank too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see no problem with that.
Let's keep singing for as long as we can.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, BAD DOGS, give us an encore!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys, that was such an amazing show! The whole place was shaking because of all the cheering!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it was a good show, but we can't let that get to our heads...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
We still have plenty of room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What?! Really?! You guys can relax a little now, right? Aren't you guys not practicing for a while either?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <An said she's busy with stuff at home, and Kohane's gone off to that seaside school or something, so I feel like you guys can have some fun...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, they're not skipping practice because they want to. We even said that we'd get right back to it once we can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, which is why we shouldn't let our guard down just because Azusawa and Shiraishi aren't here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys are so cool. That means I need to try harder too...>

E-Excuse me...!
You're Akito Shinonome, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, mind hiding for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're...

Remember me?
I'm Shota Hayashi. We used to play on the same soccer team in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being such a useless Ace.
Bye...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
Akito, please don't quit...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember. It's been a while...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I'm glad you're doing so well! We haven't talked at all since you quit playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you here, anyway...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Oh, right... I noticed you performing in that event just now and was wondering if I could ask you to do something...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You want us to do something?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah! I want you guys to perform in the live concert for the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The live concert for the Summer Festival?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: It's called the Shibuya Summer Festival. Every year, we invite artists and performers to play in the concert...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that festival.
Weren't there like pro and amateur divisions for that?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah, looks like we're on the same page! I'm actually also a part of the planning committee this year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You are?
How...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: My brother's on the committee too, but he said that they needed more people. Then I ended up having to lead all the concert stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: And we just found out that our headliner for the amateur division can't make it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you were out looking for a replacement?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Exactly! Who would've thought I'd run into you like this, Akito...? You sounded amazing up there, so I'm sure you'd be able to make just a big a splash at the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: So please, I need you guys to perform! I'm begging you...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
By the way, do you know who else will be performing?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Here's a list of all the groups.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, hold up...
These guys are pretty much all dance teams.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yes, this year we've primarily been inviting dance teams to perform in the amateur division.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you noticed during today's event that we're singers and not really dancers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hate to say this, but I'm not sure we'd fit into the overall theme you've established...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Everyone watching will want to see that sort of performance too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I completely understand how you feel...! But the headliner was also a singing group and not exactly a dance team.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Our schedule has the amateur division headliner go right before the pros take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: That's why we've reserved this slot just for someone that can really sing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-So, how about it?
I'm sure you two would be able to handle it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm for participating in this event, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He gave a reasonable explanation as to why he picked us, complimented our singing ability and made it clear that he needs our help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We even happen to be open just around the time of the festival too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But since we're gonna be surrounded by dance teams, we should include a little of that in our performance, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have ages to prepare for this concert of yours, but you think we'll be ready in time?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: No, you don't have to do that! We'd be more than happy with what you usually do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'll pretty much be just dance teams before us, right? We'd just be shortchanging the crowd if we get up there and don't dance at all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just like you to think that, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that our act will benefit from the addition of a few dance sequences, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We won't be able to practice singing as much, but it may help us down the road by learning to do something new like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Something new. Something other than singing... Somewhere new might be a nice change of pace too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll do it...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
What?! You will?!
Thanks! You're a lifesaver...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It looks like we have something to gain from this too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But again, we're not shortchanging the crowd. If we're gonna be the headliners, we've gotta sing AND dance.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Reliable ol' Akito...
You haven't changed one bit since then.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Again, thanks. I'll do whatever I can to support you guys along the way too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, just make sure to tell us once you've got all the details worked out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And now we're performing in the Summer Festival...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You are?
Toya, does that mean you've...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am genuinely excited about performing in this event and plan on doing everything I can to make it a success.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, it will also be my first time going to the Summer Festival, so I can't wait to see what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Whatever...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, can I come out now...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you should be fine now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry about that, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No, don't worry about it!
But since you guys are going to the Summer Festival now, can I come with you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but we're not going just to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I know!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But you're gonna be singing and dancing, right? So you'll be doing dance practices too?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Then, can I help you with that?
I even just got a new pair of shoes.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They fit really nicely, so I'm thinking about turning them into my dancing shoes!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dancing shoes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was told that it's good to have several pairs of shoes for when you're working on complicated dance sequences!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Like this!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see. That's very cool.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I know, right?!
I was saying how my old shoes were getting worn out, and KAITO just ended up giving me a brand-new pair!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's what happened, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't we practice in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And shoes just for dancing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I never really thought about it, but can't we just use what we usually wear for this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've looked this up before and found that dancing shoes, such as ballet slippers, aren't necessarily made of anything special.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's also apparently good to choose them based on their lightness or purpose, such as if they can handle tough step sequences.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt our current shoes will hinder us in any way, but it may be good to have a separate pair if we do plan on getting better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Maybe...
I'm not trying to copy Len, but it would be a source of motivation too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wanna go check some out after practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yay!
Tell me once you're done, alright?
I can't wait to see what you get!>
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, wanna call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for planning our after-party, Ena. It was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed yourself, Mizuki, but you're doing everything next time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Well, if I have time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(There's still this divide between us...
Normally, I wouldn't have to go as far as saying that I'd plan one of these to get it off the ground...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I even promised myself to just wait and see...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going home now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... Bye.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. I wanted to visit the CD shop on the way back, so I'll go with you until then, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's blocked...
They're doing construction.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're kidding. This whole road's blocked until the main intersection? I have to figure out a different way back..

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, it's sort of a scenic route, but wanna try going around and through that park over there? We can head straight for the station once we're out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's pretty far and it's still hot out, but I guess we don't have much of a choice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you and Kanade don't get enough exercise anyway, right? It'll be good for you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You hardly look all that different from me, Mizuki. Don't put yourself up on a pedestal, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, alright.
Anyway, let's go!
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
There we go!
Just cut through here, and we can head straight for the station.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never knew a shortcut like this existed...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How did you find this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I was wandering around here one time and just found this place by complete accident.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
You helped us so much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hey, what's what...?
It looks like they're getting ready for something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That board says, Shibuya Summer Festival...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, the Shibuya Summer Festival...
I think I went once when I was still in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I remember it being a lot of fun because of all the food stalls and the concert they put on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
A concert?
I wonder who's performing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can probably find out pretty quick on our phones... See? Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Hey, there's a ton of people performing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! ZEROstear's coming?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: ZEROstear? Oh, the artist that does a lot of anime songs?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They did the opening theme for a really popular show this season too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know much about anime, but they know how to get famous artists, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's just wall-to-wall A-listers!

Then off we go.
You too, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, I'm getting pretty hungry.
I should probably get something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, they're selling honeycomb toffees over there. They look very appetizing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They do look good, but I was thinking about getting some real food, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to get something to eat too. Yakisoba or kushiyaki would be perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, you're clear to come out now. What do you wanna get Rin and the others?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Oh, how about those caramel apples?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sure, let's go get some.
Is there anything you'd personally like, Len?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? How did we end up next to each other...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't ask me. I'd rather be talking to Airi and everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if we walk all spread out, we'd just end up being a huge roadblock. That's how I ended up next to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, geez, I get it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And did you remember to talk to the committee people about what happened to your shoes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I never thought that they'd mistake it for their equipment. I mean, they could've at least checked what was inside first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Apparently, they mistook it for a box of extension cords. At least they found their way back to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
Didn't you bring me my shoes the last time we were here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So you still remember...
I thought you'd long since forgotten about that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Of course I remember.
How can I forget about what happened with my sandals that time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'll never forget about how I had to treat you like a princess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair! I thanked you afterward, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but you conveniently forgot that part? I still remember how I put on my sneakers and went to see the concert with you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
To think that I'd end up performing on the same stage years later...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You'd just quit playing soccer too. It was like you thought the world just ended.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Can you at least forget that part?
I'm over that and doing this now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it is cool how you've stuck with singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were the reason I started singing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Did you say something? I couldn't really hear you over all these people...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You guys!
After we eat, wanna try our hand at some ring tossing?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we can split into teams since there's so many of us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nah, I'm good. I've gotta go soon.
That includes you too, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see some interesting prizes at the ring toss stall. Just one try, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, did you forget about what we discussed with Len...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course I didn't. We're going to find the best prize and try to get it for him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With Ena and Akito, we'd have even teams of three.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, we can have a battle of the Shinonomes with Team Ena and Team Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Akiyama, what are you doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Chill, it'll be fun♪
Let's make the most of it since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we never do anything like this. How about the loser has to buy pancakes for the winner?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? I said I'm not playing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean you think you're gonna lose?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it doesn't.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then let's go.
We're keeping everyone waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, fine, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess she did save me back there. Maybe I owe her this much...)
